claims.evidence: PRIDE: 'Three independent biological replicates (BR1, BR2 and BR3) were performed'; heavy (control) and light (X2-shRNA1) conditioned media mixed 1:1 per replicate. One source per (cell population, BR) = one physical conditioned-medium sample; the same source spans its 10 gel fractions x 2 injections. Raw files S1/S2/S3 = BR1/BR2/BR3 per MaxQuant experiment names BR<n>_TR<m>.

claims.value: SILAC heavy = control stable cell line (no POPX2 shRNA; control construct not stated in deposit); SILAC light = shRNA targeting PPM1F (POPX2; X2-shRNA1)
claims.evidence: Explicit label statement, PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: 'The control cells were cultured in RPMI1640 medium containing heavy arginine and heavy lysine ... The X2-shRNA1cells were maintained in RPMI1640 medium containing light arginine and light lysine'; 'complete incorporation of heavy K8 and R6 into cellular proteins were confirmed ... in control cells'. Same orientation stated in the lab's earlier deposit PXD001618 ('The control cells were cultured in RPMI1640 medium containing heavy arginine, heavy lysine'). MaxQuant: Multiplicity 2, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg6;Lys8. DATA CHECK CONFLICT: the knock-down target PPM1F has no ratio in the secretome; exosome markers and cytokines have Ratio H/L normalized > 1 (CD9 1.41, CD63 1.41, SDCBP 1.43, TSG101 1.50, CXCL8 1.72, VEGFA 1.59, PTX3 1.41), i.e. higher in the stated CONTROL channel, whereas the abstract says silencing POPX2 increases exosome secretion and pro-angiogenic cytokines. Paper body (which would show how ratios were reported) is closed access. Per campaign rule 6 the label is not re-derived from the abstract's biological direction; the explicit statement is kept and the conflict recorded in limitations.

limitations: LABEL-DIRECTION CONFLICT (reviewer attention): the explicit PRIDE protocol (and the sister deposit PXD001618) states control = SILAC heavy (Lys8/Arg6), X2-shRNA1 = SILAC light; the deposited proteinGroups.txt shows exosome markers (CD9, CD63, SDCBP, TSG101) and cytokines (CXCL8, VEGFA, PTX3) with normalized H/L ~1.4-1.7, i.e. higher in the stated control channel, opposite to the abstract's claim that POPX2 silencing increases exosome and pro-angiogenic cytokine secretion. The closed-access paper could not be read to see how ratios were reported. The SDRF follows the explicit label statement (campaign rule 6: never re-derive labels from an abstract's biological direction); if the paper shows H = knock-down, swap characteristics/factor value[genetic modification] and source names between the heavy and light rows.

Control construct of the 'control' stable cell line is not stated in the deposit (PXD001618: 'control and POPX2 knockdown (X2-shRNA1/2) MDA-MB-231 stable cells were described previously'); value written as 'control stable cell line (no POPX2 shRNA; control construct not stated in deposit)'. shRNA sequence/clone identifier not available.

Paper (J Proteome Res 2017, doi:10.1021/acs.jproteome.6b00748) is closed access; Supplementary data 1/2 not retrieved. All values come from the PRIDE protocol text, MaxQuant output, raw header and Cellosaurus.

Not a re-deposit: PXD001618 ('Phosphatase POPX2 secretome SILAC', same lab) is a different experiment (2012 LTQ-FT runs 120218_ZSJ_SILAC_Secretome_*, 13C6-Lys/13C6-Arg labels, Mascot search, single raw.tar.gz) vs PXD003940 (2015 Q Exactive runs 151218_Songjing_SILAC_*, Lys8/Arg6, MaxQuant 1.5.2.8). No SDRF for PXD003940 in sdrf-annotated-datasets.
MaxQuant search used enzyme rule Trypsin/P; SDRF records the digestion enzyme Trypsin (campaign rule 2).
